note: Based on the original description of the new species by Mukherjee, Maiti & Saha (2008) (in English), published as Angulitermes nepalensis sp. nov.; only the soldier is described, the alate being recorded in the original as Imago - unknown. The terminal antennal segment is lost, and the antennal segment number in the original measurement table is recorded as Broken; one figure in the original (head length 1.t2) is unclear in the OCR and has been checked against the same sentence, Head Index I 0.72 × head width 1.00, as 1.12. The CITATION field on the title page of that volume is misprinted with a spider name, while the title of the text is on termites; the text title is followed for citation.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Small, pale, hook-jawed soldier. Head capsule narrowly elongate-subrectangular, widest behind the anterolateral corners, gradually narrowing posteriorly; anterolateral corners (below the antennal fossae) distinctly projecting and horn-like; frontal process large, with a rounded anterior margin, the apex upturned and directed slightly backwards, reaching or slightly surpassing the median notch of the labrum; anterior margin of the labrum with a deep angular median notch; mandibles slender, slightly incurved towards the apex, slightly longer than the head. Compared with the closely related A. dehraensis, the anterolateral corners of this species are more projecting and horn-like, the frontal process is more raised with the apex upturned and directed slightly backwards (in the latter it points forwards, not backwards), and the median notch of the labral anterior margin is deep and angular (a rounded-arc concavity in the latter).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule straw yellow, antennae and labrum concolorous with it, mandibles deep reddish brown, body and legs pale yellowish white; head capsule moderately and the body more densely hairy. Head capsule subrectangular, widest behind the anterolateral corners at the antennal fossae, gradually narrowing posteriorly and slightly concave, the posterior margin convex; anterolateral corners distinct, more strongly sclerotized. Frontal process relatively large and projecting, the anterior margin rounded, the apex hairy, slightly rounded and upturned, reaching or sometimes slightly surpassing the median notch of the labrum. Fontanelle below the frontal process, projecting, more sparsely hairy than the head, the fontanelle gland large and distinct. Eyes and ocelli absent. Terminal antennal segment lost (broken); segments 1 and 2 sparsely hairy, the remaining segments more densely hairy; segment 2 slightly smaller than segment 3, segment 4 much smaller than segment 3, segments 5—8 clavate and gradually longer, segment 9 to the penultimate segment nearly equal to or shorter than segment 8. Postclypeus weakly inflated and hairy, anteclypeus white and hairless. Labrum slightly longer than wide, the anterolateral corners with horn-like projections, the anterior margin deeply angularly concave and hairy, the lateral margins narrowing posteriorly. Mandibles of the hook-jaw type, slender, the apex directed slightly outwards and incurved, slightly longer than the head. Postmentum short, club-shaped, widest slightly behind the anterior margin, with weak transverse striae, hairless, the lateral margins weakly concave at the base, the anterior margin nearly straight, the posterior margin weakly concave. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, the anterior margin markedly uprolled; wider than long, distinctly narrower than the head capsule; anterior margin without a median notch, rather densely hairy. Legs slender and short, hairy, tibial spur formula 3:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented, claws weak. Abdomen elongate-oval, short, rather densely hairy; cerci 2-segmented and hairy, styli absent.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Measurements (holotype soldier, in mm): body length 3.50, head length to the lateral mandibular bases 1.12, head length to the apex of the frontal process 1.20, maximum head width 1.00, maximum head height 0.60, maximum height of the frontal process 0.27, head index I (width/length) 0.72, head index II (height/width) 0.69, head index III (height/length) 0.55, labrum maximum length 0.22, excluding the apex 0.19, maximum width 0.20, left mandible maximum length 1.30, head-mandible index (left mandible length/head length) 1.08, postmentum minimum length 0.38, maximum width 0.27, minimum width 0.20, constriction index 0.68, pronotum maximum length 0.12, maximum width 0.35, pronotum index 0.34, head-pronotum width index 0.35, antennal segment number (broken). Holotype soldier in the Zoological Survey of India (ZSI, Kolkata), paratype soldier in the same place; the type locality only is known: central Himalaya, 10 miles north-east of Tananpur, Nepal forest, collected by K. Krishna, 1953-01-31, in soil under a stone.
